brief.tc: 目前有8個水務暫停，涉及中西區、九龍城區、元朗區、北區、南區和大埔區。醫院急症室的等待時間最長為威爾斯親王醫院的8小時。香港的空氣質素指數為4，風速最高為18公里每小時。現時有47架飛機在空中，8架在地面。
brief.en: There are currently 8 active water suspensions affecting Central and Western District, Kowloon City District, Yuen Long District, North District, Southern District, and Tai Po District. The longest waiting time in emergency departments is 8 hours at Prince of Wales Hospital. The air quality index in Hong Kong is 4, with a maximum wind speed of 18 kilometers per hour. There are 47 aircraft airborne and 8 on the ground.
